searchText: I am not able to attend today I don't know if there is much value to keep the breakout series, we can organize one-off calls if necessary <@360491619402776577> I have been reviewing the SSZ spec and it looks good so far. What I miss is the migration to REST+SSZ and future maintenance. If there were any decisions made regarding that, I'd appreciate if you could share it Not yet, I think clients are currently in the stage of implementing the spec, our own implementation is a vibe coded pos. Once we have implementations and test cases, we can discuss migration paths makes sense to me. i am thinking about making a snapshot of Engine API at some fork and use it as the base ground for REST+SSZ, starting from which any further update to the Engine API will be applied to that spec version and at the same time deprecate JSON-RPC one. But this can be possible only when each client has an implementation
